item.title: The 50,000th Reason Why Not to Take CNN’s ‘Great Depression’ Calls Seriously Ever Again
item.description: The 50,000th Reason Why Not to Take CNN’s ‘Great Depression’ Calls Seriously Ever Again Nearly a year has passed and the stock market catastrophe that CNN was predicting was just on the horizon because of President Donald Trump’s tariffs still never materialized.
